note: Day-by-day plan extracted from the 'Asia Disney Adventure' trip-plan artifact. Insert into itinerary_items with created_by set to a real profiles.id — see CLAUDE.md.

items.title: Arrive & check in
items.description: Land, transfer, settle into the Tokyo Disney Resort hotel. Realistic check-in is 5–8pm once you factor immigration and baggage for 13 people. Dinner: Toraji at Ikspiari — grill-your-own yakiniku, ~¥5,000/person; call ahead for a table for 13.

items.title: Tokyo DisneySea
items.description: Full park day — the first of four Disney days on this trip.

items.title: Tokyo day — vote needed
items.description: Check out of the Disney hotel, luggage to the Sagawa Express counter at Tokyo Station, evening Shinkansen to Kyoto. Options: Sightseeing (Meiji Shrine → Round1 Stadium, Odaiba), Shopping (Takeshita St → Omotesando → Shibuya → Don Quijote), or Foodie (Mitsukoshi depachika → Tsukiji Outer Market → ramen → Harajuku crepes).

items.title: Kinkaku-ji → Arashiyama → Nara
items.description: Morning: the Golden Pavilion, then the Arashiyama bamboo grove. Afternoon: Nara's deer park and Todai-ji's Great Buddha Hall, 35–45 min by train. Back to Kyoto that night. Self-guided.

items.title: Fly Kansai → Beijing
items.description: Departing from Kansai (KIX) rather than Tokyo, since Kyoto is the last Japan stop.

items.title: Great Wall at Mutianyu
items.description: Full day — ~1.5hr each way, 2–3+ hours on the wall, cable car up and toboggan down. Evening: Peking duck, then a Kung Fu or acrobatics show.

items.title: Tiananmen Square & Forbidden City
items.description: The two sit directly across from each other, same subway stop. Afternoon: Temple of Heaven (Summer Palace and Olympic Park are still possible swaps).

items.title: High-speed train to Shanghai
items.description: ~4.5–6hr ride. A morning departure lands by early afternoon — walk the Bund once the lights come on (~6pm), dinner nearby.

items.title: Half day Disney, then Pearl Tower & night cruise
items.description: Oriental Pearl Tower + Huangpu River night cruise as one combo ticket (~$37–47/person). Night departures start ~6:30pm.

items.title: Fly to Hong Kong
items.description: ~3hr flight, no time zone change. Evening: Temple Street Night Market — street food, shopping, fortune-tellers.

items.title: Hong Kong Disneyland
items.description: The one Hong Kong park day.

items.title: Big Buddha, then home
items.description: If the flight time allows: Ngong Ping 360 cable car + the Big Buddha on Lantau, ~10 min from the airport. Then fly home.
